imageAlt: A medical worker preparing a blood collection tray

title.zh: 出汗后起小疹子，是痱子吗？
title.en: An itchy rash after sweating: could it be heat rash?

summary.zh: 痱子常与汗液排出受阻有关，降温和减少刺激是第一步。
summary.en: Heat rash can occur when sweat ducts are blocked; cooling helps.

body.zh:
## 炎热和出汗可能是线索
痱子通常与出汗多、汗液排出受阻有关，可能出现细小皮疹和刺痒感。婴儿也可能出现，但不是所有夏季皮疹都是痱子，单靠外观或照片不能确诊。

## 保持凉爽，观察变化
选择宽松衣物，在凉爽处休息，可用凉湿布缓解不适，尽量不要抓挠。几天仍不见好转，或婴儿皮疹让家长担心时应咨询医生；伴严重不适、呼吸困难或迅速恶化时应及时求助。
body.en:
## Heat and sweat are clues, not a diagnosis
Heat rash can occur when sweat ducts become blocked. Small spots and a prickly or itchy feeling may appear, including in babies. Not every summer rash is heat rash, and appearance alone cannot establish a diagnosis.

## Cool down and watch for change
Wear loose clothing, rest somewhere cool and use a cool damp cloth for comfort. Avoid scratching. Consult a clinician if the rash does not improve after a few days or a baby’s rash worries you. Seek prompt help for severe illness, breathing difficulty or rapid worsening.

sources.title: NHS · Heat rash (reviewed 2024)

imageAlt: A small fan on a counter

title.zh: 晒伤后，先离开阳光，再考虑怎样护理
title.en: After sunburn, get out of the sun first

summary.zh: 凉水和温和护理可能缓解不适，严重晒伤需要医疗评估。
summary.en: Cool water and gentle care can help; severe sunburn needs assessment.

body.zh:
## 先让皮肤停止受晒
晒伤是皮肤受到过量紫外线的损伤，可能发红、疼痛或起水疱。离开阳光，用凉水淋浴或凉湿布轻敷，保持皮肤舒适；不要用冰块直接接触皮肤，也不要弄破水疱。

## 留意严重程度
水疱或肿胀明显、发热、头晕、恶心或全身不适时应尽快就医；婴幼儿晒伤也应及时咨询医生。恢复期间用衣物遮盖并避免继续暴晒，之后仍需要遮阳和防晒。
body.en:
## Stop further exposure
Sunburn is skin damage caused by too much ultraviolet radiation. Skin may become painful, red or blistered. Move out of the sun and use a cool shower or damp cloth for comfort. Do not put ice directly on the skin or burst blisters.

## Check how serious it is
Seek prompt medical advice for substantial blistering or swelling, fever, dizziness, nausea or feeling unwell. Sunburn in a baby or young child also deserves advice. Cover the skin and avoid further sun while it heals; protection remains important afterwards.

sources.title: NHS · Sunburn (reviewed 2025)

imageAlt: A sunscreen bottle on a beach towel

title.zh: 把水烧开能解决所有饮水污染吗？
title.en: Does boiling make every contaminated water source safe?

summary.zh: 煮沸能处理许多病原体，但不能去除有害化学物。
summary.en: Boiling can kill many germs but does not remove harmful chemicals.

body.zh:
## 先弄清楚污染类型
在病原体污染风险下，充分煮沸是处理饮水的重要方法。当地发布饮水通知时，应按通知要求选择煮沸水或安全的瓶装水，并使用清洁容器储存。

## 化学污染是另一回事
如果水中可能有燃油、有毒化学物或其他污染物，煮沸不能保证安全。不要依靠闻气味或观察颜色判断；改用可靠的替代水源，并向当地供水部门或卫生部门咨询。
body.en:
## Identify the type of problem
Boiling is an important way to kill many disease-causing germs. During a drinking-water advisory, follow local instructions about boiling or using safe bottled water, and store treated water in clean containers.

## Chemicals are a different problem
If water may contain fuel, toxic chemicals or other harmful substances, boiling does not make it reliably safe. Smell and appearance cannot establish safety. Use a reliable alternative source and follow advice from local water or health authorities.

sources.title: CDC · Household Water Treatment (2024)

imageAlt: A pot of water on a stove

title.zh: 哮喘吸入器：为什么需要让医生看一遍用法？
title.en: Why inhaler technique deserves a practical check

summary.zh: 不同吸入装置的用法不同，正确操作影响药物进入肺部。
summary.en: Different inhalers require different techniques to deliver medicine effectively.

body.zh:
## 拿到药不等于用对了
吸入器的种类不同，吸气方式、准备步骤和是否需要储雾罐也可能不同。操作不正确时，药物可能无法有效到达肺部。即使用过很久，也值得定期让医生或药师检查。

## 带着装置去复诊
请医疗人员示范，再自己操作给对方看；不确定如何清洁或判断剩余剂量时也可以当面询问。不要因为症状暂时减轻就自行更改治疗；呼吸明显困难或急救药未能缓解时应立即求助。
body.en:
## Having an inhaler is not the same as using it correctly
Devices differ in preparation, breathing technique and whether a spacer is appropriate. Incorrect technique can reduce the medicine reaching the lungs. A clinician or pharmacist can check your technique regularly, even if you have used the device for years.

## Bring it to an appointment
Ask for a demonstration, then show the professional how you use it. Ask about cleaning and checking remaining doses. Do not change treatment simply because symptoms improve. Seek urgent help for severe breathing difficulty or symptoms not relieved by your emergency treatment.

sources.title: NHS Kent · Good inhaler technique (2024)
NHS · Asthma

imageAlt: A person holding a nebulizer mask

title.zh: 腹泻或呕吐后，为什么不能马上给别人做饭？
title.en: Why preparing food should wait after vomiting or diarrhoea

summary.zh: 症状好转后仍可能传播病原体，洗手和休息都重要。
summary.en: Germs can still spread after symptoms improve; time and handwashing matter.

body.zh:
## 症状消失不一定意味着不再传播
诺如病毒可通过患病者处理的食物传播。腹泻或呕吐时不要为他人准备食物。美国疾控中心建议食品从业者在诺如病毒症状停止后至少等待48小时再处理食物；当地规定可能更严格。

## 肥皂和流水不能省
如厕后以及接触食物前认真用肥皂和流水洗手。酒精免洗洗手液可作为补充，但不能代替洗手。涉及学校、餐饮或照护工作时，应遵循机构与当地卫生部门要求。
body.en:
## Feeling better does not necessarily end transmission
Norovirus can spread through food handled by someone who is ill. Do not prepare food for others while vomiting or having diarrhoea. CDC recommends food workers wait at least 48 hours after norovirus symptoms stop; local rules may be stricter.

## Soap and running water still matter
Wash hands carefully after using the toilet and before handling food. Alcohol hand sanitiser can be an additional measure but is not a substitute for handwashing. Follow workplace and local public health rules in food service, schools and care settings.

sources.title: CDC · Norovirus illness: facts for food handlers (2024)

imageAlt: Hands being washed under running water

title.zh: 旅行前查疫苗，为什么不要等到出发前一天？
title.en: Why travel vaccine planning starts before departure

summary.zh: 目的地、行程和已有接种记录都会影响出行前建议。
summary.en: Destination, itinerary and vaccination history all shape travel advice.

body.zh:
## 建议取决于去哪里、做什么
不同目的地和活动有不同的感染风险。旅行前整理常规接种记录，了解当地疾病信息，并告诉医生计划停留的地区、时间和活动。

## 给准备留出余地
部分疫苗需要多剂次或一定时间建立保护，建议尽早咨询旅行医学门诊或接种机构。即使出发时间临近，也可以咨询其他预防措施；不要自行使用预防药物。
body.en:
## The itinerary matters
Infection risks differ by destination and activity. Review routine vaccination records before travelling and tell a clinician where you are going, how long you will stay and what you plan to do.

## Leave time to prepare
Some vaccines need more than one dose or time to produce protection, so contact a travel health or vaccination service early. Even when departure is close, ask about other precautions. Do not start preventive medicines without individual advice.

sources.title: CDC · Need travel vaccines? Plan ahead

imageAlt: Travel planning with a map and passport

title.zh: 泳池纸尿裤能阻止病菌进入水里吗？
title.en: Swim diapers are not a germ-proof barrier

summary.zh: 泳池纸尿裤不能阻止腹泻病原体进入水中。
summary.en: Swim diapers do not prevent diarrhoea-causing germs from entering water.

body.zh:
## 它不是密封屏障
泳池纸尿裤可能暂时留住部分成形粪便，但不能有效阻止腹泻及其病原体进入泳池。孩子有腹泻时，即使穿着泳池纸尿裤，也不应下水。

## 在远离池边的地方更换
定期检查纸尿裤，在指定更换区而不是池边更换，之后用肥皂和水洗手。年幼儿童在水中或水边仍需要成年人持续、近距离看护。
body.en:
## Swim diapers are not watertight
A swim diaper may temporarily contain some solid stool, but it does not reliably keep diarrhoea or the germs it carries out of pool water. A child with diarrhoea should stay out of the water, even with a swim diaper.

## Change away from the pool
Check diapers regularly and change them in a designated area away from the pool, then wash hands with soap and water. Young children still need close, constant adult supervision in and around water.

sources.title: CDC · Tips for Using Swim Diapers (2024)

imageAlt: An adult holding a baby in a swimming pool

title.zh: 预防跌倒，老年人的活动不只有散步
title.en: Balance is part of staying active as we age

summary.zh: 适合个人能力的平衡和力量活动，有助于维持行动能力。
summary.en: Appropriate balance and strength activities help support mobility.

body.zh:
## 活动可以练习不同能力
身体活动不只有走路：适合个人能力的力量和平衡练习也有助于维持行动能力、降低跌倒风险。可以从容易完成的动作开始，逐渐增加，并选择安全的活动空间。

## 根据身体状况调整
如果已经跌倒、走路不稳，或有慢性病和行动困难，应咨询医生或康复专业人员，了解适合的练习。检查鞋子、照明和地面障碍也有帮助；不必独自尝试让自己失去平衡的动作。
body.en:
## Movement can build different abilities
Activity is more than walking. Strength and balance exercises suited to an individual’s ability can support mobility and reduce falls. Begin with manageable movements, build gradually and choose a safe space.

## Adapt to the person
After a fall, with unsteady walking, chronic illness or mobility difficulties, ask a clinician or rehabilitation professional what is appropriate. Check footwear, lighting and obstacles at home too. Do not attempt unsafe balance challenges alone.

sources.title: WHO · Physical activity and ageing

imageAlt: An older adult practicing tai chi outdoors

title.zh: 眼睛发红时，哪些情况不能只等它自己好？
title.en: When a red eye needs prompt attention

summary.zh: 疼痛、怕光和视力变化不是普通刺激就能解释的。
summary.en: Eye pain, light sensitivity and vision changes need assessment.

body.zh:
## 红眼有不同原因
结膜炎可由感染或过敏引起，可能伴流泪、瘙痒或分泌物。不要仅凭眼红判断病因，也不要共用毛巾或揉眼；感染性结膜炎可能传播。

## 这些信号需要尽快就医
眼睛疼痛、明显怕光、视力变化或眼红严重时，应尽快寻求医疗评估。佩戴隐形眼镜的人若出现红眼或不适，应取下镜片并咨询眼科人员；出生不满30天的婴儿红眼需要紧急评估。
body.en:
## Redness has more than one cause
Conjunctivitis can result from infection or allergy and may cause watering, itching or discharge. Redness alone does not identify the cause. Avoid rubbing your eyes or sharing towels; infectious conjunctivitis can spread.

## Do not wait with warning signs
Eye pain, marked light sensitivity, vision changes or severe redness need prompt assessment. Contact lens wearers with a red or uncomfortable eye should remove the lenses and seek eye-care advice. A baby under 30 days old with a red eye needs urgent assessment.

sources.title: NHS · Conjunctivitis (reviewed 2024)

imageAlt: A towel hanging in a bathroom

title.zh: 月经量大到影响生活，值得和医生谈谈
title.en: Heavy periods that disrupt life deserve attention

summary.zh: 月经量多有多种原因，也可能导致缺铁性贫血。
summary.en: Heavy bleeding has several possible causes and can contribute to anaemia.

body.zh:
## 不必把困扰当作理所当然
月经量和持续时间因人而异，但如果频繁需要更换卫生用品、影响上学工作或伴明显疲劳，就值得寻求评估。长期出血较多可能导致缺铁性贫血。

## 记录有助于沟通
记录经期天数、需要更换用品的频率和伴随症状，带给医疗人员。医生可能根据情况安排血液检查并讨论治疗。若出血非常多并伴头晕、晕厥或明显虚弱，应立即寻求医疗帮助。
body.en:
## Disruption is worth discussing
Periods vary, but frequently needing to change menstrual products, missing school or work, or feeling unusually tired deserves assessment. Ongoing heavy bleeding can contribute to iron-deficiency anaemia.

## Bring a simple record
Note the number of days, how often products need changing and any accompanying symptoms. A clinician may recommend blood tests and discuss treatment according to the cause. Seek urgent help for very heavy bleeding with dizziness, fainting or marked weakness.

sources.title: NHS · Heavy periods

imageAlt: A calendar and pen

title.zh: 为什么艾滋病毒感染者需要特别关注结核病？
title.en: Why TB prevention matters for people living with HIV

summary.zh: 免疫功能降低会增加结核感染发展为结核病的风险。
summary.en: Reduced immune function raises the risk of TB disease after infection.

body.zh:
## 两种感染需要一起考虑
艾滋病毒会影响免疫系统。对已经感染结核菌的人，免疫功能降低会增加发展为结核病的风险，但这并不意味着每位艾滋病毒感染者都有结核病。

## 检查和治疗要个体化
医疗人员可结合症状、接触史和免疫状况安排结核评估。排除活动性结核病后，部分人可能适合预防性治疗。结核药物和抗病毒药物之间可能有相互作用，应由医疗团队协调，不要自行调整。
body.en:
## Consider both infections together
HIV affects the immune system. For someone with TB infection, reduced immune function increases the risk of developing TB disease. This does not mean everyone living with HIV has TB.

## Assessment and treatment are individual
A care team can assess TB using symptoms, exposure history and immune status. After active TB disease is excluded, preventive treatment may be suitable for some people. TB and HIV medicines can interact, so the care team should coordinate treatment; do not adjust medicines independently.

sources.title: CDC · Clinical Care for People with TB and HIV

imageAlt: A doctor speaking with a patient

title.zh: 服用抗生素后不舒服，怎样判断是否需要求助？
title.en: Feeling unwell after an antibiotic: when to get help

summary.zh: 恶心和腹泻可能是副作用；呼吸困难和面部肿胀需要急救。
summary.en: Nausea and diarrhoea can be side effects; breathing trouble requires urgent help.

body.zh:
## 副作用与过敏并不完全相同
抗生素可能引起恶心或腹泻等不适，但不是所有不适都是过敏。记录药名、服药时间和症状变化，并联系开药医生或药师，帮助判断下一步。

## 严重反应不要等待
若出现呼吸困难、喉咙或面部肿胀、昏厥或严重皮肤反应，应立即呼叫急救。不要借用别人的药或自行决定以后是否能使用同类药物；把明确的反应经过告知医疗人员。
body.en:
## Side effects and allergies are not identical
Antibiotics can cause nausea or diarrhoea, but not every unpleasant effect is an allergy. Record the medicine, timing and symptoms, and contact the prescribing clinician or pharmacist for advice.

## Do not wait with severe symptoms
Breathing difficulty, swelling of the face or throat, collapse or a severe skin reaction requires emergency help. Do not borrow another person’s medicines or decide independently whether a related medicine is safe in future. Tell healthcare professionals exactly what happened.

sources.title: NHS · Antibiotic side effects

imageAlt: An assortment of packaged tablets

title.zh: 结核治疗期间尿液变橙色，需要担心吗？
title.en: Orange urine during TB treatment: what does it mean?

summary.zh: 某些药物会改变体液颜色，但其他症状仍需要及时报告。
summary.en: Some medicines change body-fluid colour; other symptoms need prompt attention.

body.zh:
## 颜色变化可能与药物有关
利福平或利福喷汀可能让尿液、眼泪或汗液变橙色，这是常见且无害的作用。软性隐形眼镜也可能被永久染色，开始治疗时可以向医生询问。

## 颜色之外还要看症状
食欲明显下降、持续恶心、褐色尿液、眼白或皮肤发黄，以及视力改变等，都应立即联系治疗团队。不要把所有变化都归结为正常反应；出现严重反应时按医生指示处理。
body.en:
## A medicine can change the colour
Rifampin or rifapentine can turn urine, tears or sweat orange. This is a common, harmless effect; soft contact lenses can also be permanently stained. Ask your care team what to expect when starting treatment.

## Pay attention to more than colour
Report loss of appetite, persistent nausea, brown urine, yellow skin or eyes, or changes in vision promptly. Do not assume every new symptom is harmless. Follow your clinician’s instructions about serious reactions.

sources.title: CDC · Adverse events during TB treatment (2025)

imageAlt: Pills beside a medicine bottle

title.zh: 怀孕时发现结核病，还能接受治疗吗？
title.en: TB during pregnancy: why timely care matters

summary.zh: 孕期结核评估和用药需要个体化，不应自行等待或停药。
summary.en: TB assessment and treatment in pregnancy require individual medical guidance.

body.zh:
## 感染与发病需要区分
怀孕期间发现结核感染，不等于已经患有活动性结核病。医生会结合症状、接触史和检查结果评估，也会考虑孕期的特殊情况。

## 和医疗团队一起决定
活动性结核病不应因为怀孕而自行拖延治疗；未经治疗的疾病会对孕妇和胎儿造成风险。潜伏感染的治疗时机则因个人风险而异。告知医生怀孕或备孕情况，由专业人员选择方案并随访。
body.en:
## Infection and disease are different
A positive TB infection test in pregnancy does not by itself mean active TB disease. Clinicians consider symptoms, exposure and test results alongside the needs of pregnancy.

## Make the plan together
Do not delay care for active TB simply because of pregnancy: untreated disease can pose risks to both parent and baby. Timing for preventive treatment of inactive infection depends on individual risk. Tell the care team about pregnancy or pregnancy plans so they can choose and monitor treatment.

sources.title: CDC · Tuberculosis in pregnancy (2025)

imageAlt: A clinician speaks with a pregnant patient

title.zh: 停电后，冰箱里的食物还能吃吗？
title.en: After a power outage, what happens to refrigerated food?

summary.zh: 关紧冰箱门能延缓升温，但易腐食物不能无限期保存。
summary.en: Keeping the fridge closed slows warming, but perishable food has limits.

body.zh:
## 尽量少开冰箱门
停电时保持冰箱门关闭。美国疾控中心指出，关闭的冷藏室通常能让食物保持安全约四小时；实际情况还取决于温度和是否有其他冷源。

## 不要靠尝一口判断
没有其他冷源且停电超过四小时，应丢弃肉、鱼、蛋、奶和剩菜等易腐冷藏食品。外观和气味正常也不代表安全，不要通过品尝判断。对药品或特殊食品的储存，另行咨询专业人员。
body.en:
## Keep the door closed
During an outage, keep refrigerator and freezer doors shut. CDC guidance says a closed refrigerator generally keeps food safe for up to four hours; actual conditions depend on temperature and other cold sources.

## Never taste food to check safety
After four hours without power or another cold source, discard refrigerated perishables such as meat, fish, eggs, milk and leftovers. Food can be unsafe even when it looks and smells normal. Ask a professional separately about medicines or special foods.

sources.title: CDC · Keep food safe after an emergency (2024)

imageAlt: Food stored in a refrigerator

title.zh: 六个月左右，宝宝为什么开始需要辅食？
title.en: Why complementary feeding begins around six months

summary.zh: 辅食是对母乳或配方奶的补充，食物的质地和安全同样重要。
summary.en: Complementary foods add to milk feeds; texture and safety matter too.

body.zh:
## 从补充开始
大约六个月时，单靠母乳或配方奶通常已不足以满足婴儿不断增长的营养需要。辅食是逐步添加的食物，并不意味着立即停止母乳或配方奶。

## 因人调整
从适合发育阶段的质地和少量食物开始，逐渐增加种类；进食时有成年人陪伴，避免容易造成噎塞的食物形态。早产、过敏或喂养困难的宝宝，应向儿科医生咨询个体化建议。
body.en:
## Food complements milk
Around six months, breast milk or formula alone generally no longer meets all of a growing infant’s nutritional needs. Complementary foods are introduced gradually; they do not mean stopping milk feeds immediately.

## Adapt to the child
Start with small amounts and textures suited to the child’s development, then gradually offer variety. Supervise eating and avoid shapes that can cause choking. Ask a paediatric professional for individual advice about prematurity, allergies or feeding difficulties.

sources.title: WHO · Complementary feeding guideline (2023)

imageAlt: A young child eating with a spoon

title.zh: 洪水退后，为什么要尽快处理潮湿物品？
title.en: After flooding, drying is part of mould prevention

summary.zh: 潮湿环境有利于霉菌生长，安全清理从排除电气风险开始。
summary.en: Damp materials can support mould; check electrical safety before cleanup.

body.zh:
## 尽快干燥，但安全优先
洪水过后，如果能够安全进入，应尽快清洁并干燥受潮区域。美国疾控中心建议尽可能在24至48小时内完成干燥，以减少霉菌生长。切勿在不安全的积水中使用电器。

## 清理时保护自己
根据污染程度佩戴手套、护目装备和合适的呼吸防护。无法彻底清洁和干燥的多孔物品可能需要丢弃；不要用油漆直接覆盖霉斑，也不要混合漂白剂和其他清洁剂。大面积污染或健康状况特殊时寻求专业帮助。
body.en:
## Dry promptly, with safety first
Once it is safe to enter, clean and dry wet areas as soon as possible. CDC recommends drying within 24 to 48 hours when feasible to limit mould growth. Never use electrical appliances in unsafe standing water.

## Protect yourself during cleanup
Use gloves, eye protection and appropriate respiratory protection for the conditions. Porous items that cannot be cleaned and dried may need to be discarded. Do not paint over mould or mix bleach with other cleaners. Seek professional help for extensive contamination or particular health concerns.

sources.title: CDC · 8 tips to clean up mold

imageAlt: A close view of a damaged wall

title.zh: 积水看起来不深，为什么也不宜涉水？
title.en: Floodwater can hide more than its depth

summary.zh: 流速、井盖和电线都可能藏在水面下，绕行通常更安全。
summary.en: Current, missing covers and electrical hazards can be hidden beneath water.

body.zh:
## 水面不能告诉你全部情况
洪水可能掩盖路面破损、井盖缺失、尖锐物或带电设施，水流也可能比看起来更强。不要步行或驾车穿越不明深度的积水。

## 先离开危险区域
遵循当地预警和疏散指示，选择安全路线。如果被困在高处，留在安全位置并联系救援，不要自行进入洪水。受污染的洪水也不应用于饮用或准备食物。
body.en:
## The surface hides hazards
Floodwater can conceal damaged roads, missing covers, sharp objects and electrical hazards. The current may be stronger than it appears. Do not walk or drive through water of unknown depth.

## Move away from danger
Follow local warnings and evacuation instructions, and choose a safe route. If stranded above floodwater, stay in a safe place and call for rescue rather than entering the water. Contaminated floodwater should not be used for drinking or food preparation.

sources.title: WHO Europe · Health advice after flooding (2023)

imageAlt: A flooded street

title.zh: 有人呕吐后，清洁和消毒为什么要分两步？
title.en: After vomiting, cleaning and disinfection both matter

summary.zh: 先安全清除污染物，再按产品说明进行消毒。
summary.en: Remove contamination safely, then disinfect according to product instructions.

body.zh:
## 尽快处理污染
诺如病毒可能通过呕吐物和受污染的表面传播。清理时戴一次性手套，先移除可见污染物，再清洁周围可能受污染的表面。处理完后用肥皂和流动水认真洗手。

## 选择合适的消毒产品
使用标明对诺如病毒有效的消毒产品，按标签要求配制并保持接触时间。漂白剂不能与其他清洁剂混合，应保持通风；受污染衣物按产品说明清洗。症状严重或出现脱水迹象时寻求医疗帮助。
body.en:
## Deal with contamination promptly
Norovirus can spread through vomit and contaminated surfaces. Wear disposable gloves, remove visible material first and clean surrounding surfaces that may have been contaminated. Afterwards, wash hands thoroughly with soap and running water.

## Choose an appropriate disinfectant
Use a product labelled effective against norovirus and follow its dilution and contact-time instructions. Never mix bleach with other cleaners; ventilate the area. Launder contaminated clothing as directed. Seek medical advice for severe symptoms or signs of dehydration.

sources.title: CDC · How to prevent norovirus (2025)

imageAlt: Gloved hands cleaning a surface

title.zh: 防晒霜和驱蚊剂，应该先涂哪个？
title.en: Sunscreen and insect repellent: which goes on first?

summary.zh: 通常先涂防晒霜，再使用驱蚊剂，并分别遵循标签。
summary.en: Generally apply sunscreen first, then repellent, following each label.

body.zh:
## 两种产品分开用
户外既要防晒也要防蚊时，一般先涂防晒霜，再使用驱蚊剂。优先分别使用两种产品，因为防晒霜往往需要更频繁地补涂。

## 使用时看标签
驱蚊剂应按说明用于暴露的皮肤或衣物，不要喷在伤口、眼睛或嘴附近；给儿童使用时由成年人操作，并选择适合年龄的产品。衣物用的氯菊酯不应涂在皮肤上。
body.en:
## Use separate products
When you need both sun and insect protection, generally apply sunscreen first and repellent afterwards. Separate products are useful because sunscreen often needs reapplication more frequently.

## Read the labels
Apply repellent to exposed skin or clothing as directed, avoiding wounds, eyes and mouth. Adults should apply it for children using an age-appropriate product. Permethrin intended for clothing must not be applied to skin.

sources.title: CDC Yellow Book · Mosquitoes, ticks and other arthropods (2025)

imageAlt: A close view of a mosquito

title.zh: 冷冻肉放在台面上解冻，问题出在哪里？
title.en: Why thawing meat on the counter is risky

summary.zh: 外层可能先进入细菌容易繁殖的温度，即使中心仍然冷。
summary.en: The outside can warm into a range where bacteria grow while the centre stays cold.

body.zh:
## 外面和里面升温不同
冷冻肉放在室温台面上，表面可能已经变暖，而中心仍未解冻。较温暖的外层给细菌繁殖提供了机会。

## 提前计划更省心
可在冰箱冷藏室解冻，并用容器接住汁液，避免污染其他食物。也可采用冷水或微波炉解冻，但应遵循食品安全指导，并在适用时及时烹饪。不要靠闻味道判断食物是否安全。
body.en:
## The outside warms first
On a room-temperature counter, the surface of frozen meat can warm while the centre is still frozen. The warmer outer layer gives bacteria an opportunity to grow.

## Plan ahead
Thaw in the refrigerator in a container that catches juices and keeps them away from other foods. Cold water and microwave thawing are alternatives when food-safety instructions are followed and food is cooked promptly as appropriate. Smell cannot establish safety.

sources.title: CDC · Four steps to food safety

imageAlt: Raw chicken on a board

title.zh: 严重过敏时，为什么不能只等待药片起效？
title.en: Anaphylaxis needs an emergency plan

summary.zh: 严重过敏反应可能迅速恶化，需要立即急救和医疗评估。
summary.en: Anaphylaxis can worsen quickly and needs emergency treatment.

body.zh:
## 认出危险变化
严重过敏反应可能出现呼吸困难、喉咙或舌头肿胀、头晕或意识改变，皮疹不一定明显。怀疑严重过敏时不要等待症状自行缓解。

## 立即行动
立即呼叫当地急救电话；如果患者已获处方肾上腺素自动注射器，按医生提供的急救计划立即使用。遵循急救人员指示，即使症状缓解也要接受医疗评估。抗组胺药不能替代肾上腺素急救。
body.en:
## Recognise danger
Anaphylaxis can involve breathing difficulty, swelling of the tongue or throat, dizziness or altered consciousness. A rash may not be obvious. Do not wait to see whether suspected anaphylaxis settles on its own.

## Act immediately
Call local emergency services. If the person has a prescribed adrenaline auto-injector, use it immediately according to their emergency plan. Follow emergency instructions and obtain medical assessment even if symptoms improve. Antihistamines do not replace adrenaline for anaphylaxis.

sources.title: NHS · Anaphylaxis

imageAlt: An ambulance on a city street

title.zh: 家庭急救包，为什么需要定期检查？
title.en: A first-aid kit needs checking, not just packing

summary.zh: 检查耗材、有效期和存放位置，让急救用品在需要时找得到。
summary.en: Check supplies, expiry dates and storage so essentials are ready when needed.

body.zh:
## 装好之后还要维护
急救包可以放置敷料、绷带和一次性手套等基础用品。用过之后及时补充，并定期检查包装是否破损、物品是否过期。

## 放在容易找到的位置
让家人知道急救包在哪里，同时放在儿童无法自行取用的地方。急救包不能替代医疗服务：严重出血、呼吸困难或意识异常时，应立即呼叫急救并按指示处理。
body.en:
## A kit needs maintenance
A first-aid kit may contain dressings, bandages and disposable gloves. Replace supplies after use and check regularly for damaged packaging or expired items.

## Make it easy to find
Let household members know where the kit is while keeping it out of children’s reach. A kit does not replace medical care: call emergency services for severe bleeding, breathing difficulty or altered consciousness and follow their instructions.

sources.title: NHS · What should I keep in my first aid kit?

credit: Sgt. Rafael Brambila-Pelayo / Navy Medicine / Unsplash
imageAlt: Medical supplies prepared for training

title.zh: 同一种药，为什么要留意通用名？
title.en: Why the active ingredient matters more than a familiar brand

summary.zh: 不同名称的药品可能含有相同成分，重复服用可能造成风险。
summary.en: Different products can contain the same ingredient, creating a risk of doubling up.

body.zh:
## 名称不同，成分可能相同
感冒药、止痛药等复方产品可能含有相同的有效成分。只看品牌名，容易忽略重复用药。购买或服药前查看成分、剂量和适用人群。

## 不确定时先问
如果正在服用其他药物，或者给儿童用药，请向药师或医生确认。不要把不同产品的剂量分别计算后再随意叠加；若怀疑过量，立即联系急救或当地中毒咨询服务，即使暂时没有症状。
body.en:
## Different names can hide the same ingredient
Cold remedies, pain medicines and combination products may contain the same active ingredient. Looking only at the brand can make accidental duplication easy. Check ingredients, dose and who the medicine is suitable for before use.

## Ask before combining
Speak with a pharmacist or clinician when taking other medicines or giving medicine to a child. Do not assume doses from separate products can be added freely. If an overdose is suspected, contact emergency or local poison services promptly, even if there are no immediate symptoms.

sources.title: FDA · Avoiding acetaminophen overdose

imageAlt: A tablet on a medicine organiser

title.zh: 小伤口清洗后，什么时候需要看医生？
title.en: A small cut: when does it need medical attention?

summary.zh: 清水冲洗和覆盖有助于护理，但深伤口或感染迹象不能忽视。
summary.en: Rinse and cover minor cuts, but seek help for deep wounds or infection signs.

body.zh:
## 先清洗并保护
小伤口先洗手，用流动清水冲洗伤口，再用干净敷料覆盖。轻微出血可用干净材料持续按压止血；不要把泥土留在伤口里。

## 留意变化
伤口很深、出血止不住、有异物，或出现逐渐加重的红肿、疼痛和发热时，应及时就医。动物咬伤或污染较重的伤口也需要专业评估，医疗人员可能询问破伤风疫苗接种史。
body.en:
## Clean and protect
For a minor cut, wash your hands, rinse the wound under running water and cover it with a clean dressing. Apply steady pressure with clean material for minor bleeding. Do not leave dirt in the wound.

## Watch for change
Seek medical advice for a deep wound, bleeding that will not stop, an embedded object, or increasing redness, swelling, pain or fever. Animal bites and heavily contaminated wounds also need professional assessment; a clinician may ask about tetanus vaccination.

sources.title: NHS · Cuts and grazes

imageAlt: A medical professional bandages a hand

title.zh: 结核药和其他药能一起吃吗？先给医生一份清单
title.en: TB medicines and other drugs: share the full list

summary.zh: 一些结核药会影响其他药物的作用，包括部分避孕药。
summary.en: Some TB medicines interact with other drugs, including some contraceptives.

body.zh:
## 相互作用不一定看得出来
利福平和利福喷汀等药物可能降低某些药物的效果，包括部分激素避孕药和抗凝药。相互作用因药物和个人情况而异，不能单凭有没有不舒服来判断。

## 就诊时带上完整清单
告诉医生或药师你正在使用的处方药、非处方药、补充剂和避孕方式。开始或停用其他药物前先咨询；需要更换避孕方式或调整剂量时，由医疗人员制定方案，不要自行停用结核药。
body.en:
## Interactions are not always visible
Rifampin and rifapentine can reduce the effect of some medicines, including certain hormonal contraceptives and anticoagulants. The effect depends on the medicine and the person; feeling well does not rule out an interaction.

## Bring a complete list
Tell your clinician or pharmacist about prescription and over-the-counter medicines, supplements and contraception. Ask before starting or stopping another product. Let the care team advise on alternatives or dose changes; do not stop TB treatment on your own.

sources.title: CDC · Adverse events during TB treatment

imageAlt: Medicine capsules, not identified as TB drugs

title.zh: 结核检查留痰，为什么不是吐一口口水就够了？
title.en: A TB sputum sample is not simply saliva

summary.zh: 检查通常需要来自呼吸道深处的痰，并遵循安全采集安排。
summary.en: Testing usually needs material from the lungs collected with appropriate precautions.

body.zh:
## 样本来自哪里很重要
痰来自呼吸道深处，与口腔里的唾液不同。结核检查可能需要多份样本和不同的实验室检测；不能只凭一次结果或症状判断。

## 按医疗人员安排采集
采样时间、容器和地点请遵照当地医院或疾控人员的说明，在指定、通风良好的地点采集，避免让身边人暴露。咳不出痰时不要勉强或自行改变步骤，询问是否需要其他采样方式。
body.en:
## Where the sample comes from matters
Sputum comes from deeper in the respiratory tract and differs from saliva. A TB evaluation may involve several specimens and different laboratory tests; neither a single result nor symptoms alone tell the whole story.

## Follow the collection plan
Ask the care team about timing, containers and the designated, well-ventilated collection area to reduce exposure to others. If you cannot produce sputum, do not improvise; ask whether another collection method is appropriate.

sources.title: CDC · Clinical and laboratory diagnosis for tuberculosis

imageAlt: A laboratory technician at work, not a TB test

title.zh: 流感抗病毒药为什么要尽早咨询？
title.en: Why timing matters for flu antivirals

summary.zh: 抗病毒药通常越早使用越有效，但是否需要用药由医生评估。
summary.en: Antivirals work best when started early; a clinician decides whether they are appropriate.

body.zh:
## 抗病毒药不是抗生素
流感由病毒引起。处方抗病毒药与抗生素不同，通常在发病后尽早使用效果更好，尤其是前两天内。并非每位流感患者都需要抗病毒药。

## 高风险或病情严重时不要自行放弃就医
对于重症、住院或存在并发症高风险的人，超过两天后治疗仍可能有益。尽早联系医生，告知发病时间和基础疾病；呼吸困难、意识改变等严重症状需要紧急就医。
body.en:
## Antivirals are not antibiotics
Influenza is caused by a virus. Prescription antivirals are different from antibiotics and generally work best when started early, especially within two days of illness. Not everyone with flu needs them.

## Do not rule out care after two days
For people who are seriously ill, hospitalised or at higher risk of complications, treatment may still help when started later. Contact a clinician promptly and mention when symptoms began and any underlying conditions. Breathing difficulty or altered consciousness needs emergency care.

sources.title: CDC · Treating influenza (2022)
CDC · Influenza, Yellow Book (2025)

imageAlt: Medical supplies; pictured medicines are not identified as antivirals

title.zh: 孩子发热时，除了体温还要观察什么？
title.en: A child's fever: look beyond the number

summary.zh: 精神状态、呼吸和喝水情况，与体温数字同样值得关注。
summary.en: Breathing, alertness and drinking matter alongside the temperature.

body.zh:
## 观察孩子的整体状态
用数字体温计测量，留意孩子是否能正常喝水、排尿、回应和呼吸。发热有多种原因，体温数字本身不能告诉我们病因或严重程度。

## 知道何时求助
三个月以下婴儿体温达到38℃或更高，应立即寻求医疗评估。呼吸困难、难以唤醒、抽搐、颈部僵硬，或按压不褪色的皮疹需要急救。给退热药前确认适用年龄和说明，不要自行交替使用多种药物。
body.en:
## Notice the whole child
Use a digital thermometer and watch whether the child drinks, urinates, responds and breathes normally. Fever has many causes; the number alone does not explain the cause or severity.

## Know when to seek help
A baby under three months with a temperature of 38°C or higher needs urgent medical assessment. Breathing difficulty, difficulty waking, a seizure, a stiff neck or a rash that does not fade under pressure needs emergency help. Check age and label instructions before fever medicine; do not alternate medicines without professional advice.

sources.title: NHS · High temperature in children

imageAlt: An adult takes a child's temperature

title.zh: 婴儿睡觉时，为什么床铺越简单越好？
title.en: A clear, flat sleep space for babies

summary.zh: 仰睡、平整坚实的睡面和没有松散物品的床铺有助于降低风险。
summary.en: Back sleeping and a firm, flat, clear surface help reduce sleep-related risks.

body.zh:
## 每次睡觉都仰卧
无论白天小睡还是夜间睡觉，把婴儿仰放在平整、坚实的婴儿床睡面上。避免让婴儿在成人床、沙发或倾斜睡具中无人看护地睡觉。

## 床上不放松软物品
床面使用贴合的床单，不放枕头、松软被褥、玩具或围栏垫。婴儿可以和照护者同室，但应有独立睡眠空间。特殊医疗情况应咨询儿科医生。
body.en:
## Back to sleep, every time
Place babies on their backs for naps and at night on a firm, flat sleep surface designed for infants. Avoid leaving a baby asleep unattended on an adult bed, sofa or inclined sleeper.

## Keep the space clear
Use a fitted sheet and keep pillows, loose bedding, toys and bumper pads out of the sleep space. Babies can share a room with caregivers while sleeping in their own separate space. Ask a paediatric clinician about special medical circumstances.

sources.title: CDC · Helping babies sleep safely (2024)

imageAlt: A caregiver holding a baby near a crib

title.zh: 只在窗边吸烟，能避免家人吸入二手烟吗？
title.en: An open window does not make indoor smoking safe

summary.zh: 通风不能完全消除二手烟，室内和车内无烟更能保护家人。
summary.en: Ventilation cannot eliminate secondhand smoke; smoke-free spaces offer better protection.

body.zh:
## 烟雾不只停留在吸烟者身边
二手烟来自燃烧的烟草和吸烟者呼出的烟雾。不存在已知的安全暴露水平，儿童尤其容易受到影响。

## 让共同空间无烟
开窗、使用风扇或只在另一间房间吸烟，不能完全保护同住者。让家中和车内保持无烟，并在需要时寻求戒烟支持，是更可靠的做法。
body.en:
## Smoke travels beyond the smoker
Secondhand smoke comes from burning tobacco and from smoke breathed out by a smoker. There is no known safe level of exposure, and children are especially vulnerable.

## Make shared spaces smoke-free
Opening windows, using fans or smoking in another room does not fully protect others indoors. Keeping homes and vehicles smoke-free and seeking support to quit are more reliable steps.

sources.title: CDC · About secondhand smoke (2024)

imageAlt: A cigarette held near a car window

title.zh: 抗生素期间腹泻，什么时候应联系医生？
title.en: Diarrhoea during antibiotics deserves a conversation

summary.zh: 腹泻不一定由艰难梭菌引起，但持续或严重症状需要评估。
summary.en: Not all diarrhoea is C. diff, but persistent or severe symptoms need assessment.

body.zh:
## 原因不止一种
抗生素可能引起腹泻，也可能增加艰难梭菌感染的风险；并不是每次腹泻都是这种感染。服药期间或之后出现腹泻，应联系医疗人员并说明近期用药。

## 不要硬扛严重症状
腹泻严重、伴发热、明显腹痛、血便或脱水迹象时，应尽快就医。不要自行使用止泻药掩盖严重症状，也不要未经咨询改变抗生素方案。
body.en:
## There can be different causes
Antibiotics can cause diarrhoea and can also increase the risk of C. difficile infection. Not every episode is C. diff. Contact a healthcare professional about diarrhoea during or after antibiotics and describe recent medicines.

## Do not ignore severe symptoms
Seek prompt care for severe diarrhoea, fever, significant abdominal pain, blood in the stool or signs of dehydration. Ask before using antidiarrhoeal medicine or changing an antibiotic course.

sources.title: CDC · About C. diff

imageAlt: A bottle of medication; the contents are not identified

title.zh: 为什么叶酸要在怀孕前就开始考虑？
title.en: Folic acid matters before pregnancy too

summary.zh: 神经管在孕早期发育，因此备孕时就应咨询叶酸补充。
summary.en: The neural tube develops early, so planning before pregnancy matters.

body.zh:
## 时间是关键
叶酸有助于预防部分胎儿神经管缺陷，而神经管在怀孕早期发育，可能早于发现怀孕的时间。备孕时就向医生咨询补充方案。

## 剂量需要结合个人情况
美国疾控中心建议可能怀孕的人每日摄入400微克叶酸；有特殊病史或使用某些药物的人可能需要不同方案。结合中国当地建议和个人情况咨询医生，不要自行长期服用高剂量。
body.en:
## Timing matters
Folic acid helps prevent some neural tube defects. The neural tube develops early in pregnancy, sometimes before someone knows they are pregnant, so discuss supplementation when planning pregnancy.

## The right dose depends on circumstances
CDC recommends 400 micrograms daily for people who could become pregnant; some medical histories or medicines require a different plan. Consult a clinician about local guidance and individual needs rather than taking high doses on your own.

sources.title: CDC · Folic acid safety and health outcomes (2026)

imageAlt: A pregnancy consultation; no diagnosis is implied

title.zh: 牙疼反复发作，为什么不能只靠止痛药？
title.en: Toothache needs a cause, not only pain relief

summary.zh: 止痛可能暂时缓解症状，但无法替代牙科检查和治疗。
summary.en: Pain relief can be temporary; dental assessment addresses the cause.

body.zh:
## 疼痛减轻不代表问题解决
牙疼可能与龋齿、牙龈或牙髓问题有关。持续超过两天、咬合时疼痛、发热或脸颊肿胀时，应联系牙医。止痛药不能替代针对病因的治疗。

## 肿胀影响呼吸时立即急救
如果口腔或颈部肿胀影响呼吸、吞咽或说话，应立即呼叫急救。不要自行使用剩余抗生素；是否需要药物和牙科处理应由专业人员判断。
body.en:
## Less pain does not mean the problem is fixed
Toothache can have several causes, including tooth decay and problems affecting the gums or pulp. Contact a dentist if pain lasts more than two days, hurts when biting, or comes with fever or cheek swelling. Pain relief is not treatment of the cause.

## Breathing or swallowing difficulty is urgent
Call emergency services if swelling in the mouth or neck makes breathing, swallowing or speaking difficult. Do not use leftover antibiotics; a dental professional should assess what treatment is needed.

sources.title: NHS · Toothache

imageAlt: A dentist examines a patient

title.zh: 伤口接触洪水后，为什么需要格外留意？
title.en: Open wounds and floodwater are a risky combination

summary.zh: 洪水可能含有污水和其他污染物，开放性伤口容易感染。
summary.en: Floodwater can contain sewage and other contaminants that infect open wounds.

body.zh:
## 尽量避免接触
开放性伤口或皮疹应尽量避免接触洪水。必须接触时，可用防水敷料覆盖清洁伤口；洪水可能含有污水、泥土或其他污染物。

## 清洗并观察
接触后用肥皂和清洁水充分清洗。出现红肿加重、疼痛、渗液或发热时尽快就医；刺伤、有异物或污染严重的伤口也应接受专业评估，并告知破伤风疫苗接种史。
body.en:
## Avoid exposure when possible
Keep open wounds or rashes away from floodwater. If exposure cannot be avoided, cover a clean wound with a waterproof dressing. Floodwater may contain sewage, soil or other contaminants.

## Wash and watch
After exposure, wash thoroughly with soap and clean water. Seek prompt care for increasing redness, swelling, pain, drainage or fever. Punctures, embedded objects or heavily contaminated wounds also need professional assessment; mention your tetanus vaccination history.

sources.title: CDC · Floodwater safety (2024)

imageAlt: A bandage on a finger

title.zh: 罐头鼓包，还能尝一口看看吗？
title.en: Never taste a suspicious can to check safety

summary.zh: 鼓包或泄漏的罐头可能不安全，肉毒毒素不能靠味道识别。
summary.en: Bulging or leaking containers may be unsafe; botulinum toxin cannot be tasted.

body.zh:
## 看不见不等于没有风险
肉毒毒素无法通过外观、气味或味道可靠识别。鼓包、泄漏或异常喷溅的罐头不应食用，也不要尝一口确认。

## 家庭保存要遵循可靠方法
自制低酸罐藏食品应使用经过验证的方法和适当设备；普通沸水浴并不能为所有低酸食品提供足够保护。怀疑食用后出现吞咽困难、视力变化或肌肉无力时，应立即就医。
body.en:
## Danger is not always visible
Botulinum toxin cannot reliably be seen, smelled or tasted. Do not eat food from a bulging, leaking or spurting container, and never taste it to check whether it is safe.

## Follow tested preserving methods
Home-canned low-acid foods require validated methods and appropriate equipment; a boiling-water bath is not enough for every low-acid food. Seek emergency care for difficulty swallowing, vision changes or weakness after a suspected exposure.

sources.title: CDC · Home-canned foods and botulism (2024)

imageAlt: Jars of preserved food; their safety cannot be judged from a photo

title.zh: 宠物龟看起来很健康，也需要洗手吗？
title.en: A healthy-looking turtle can still carry Salmonella

summary.zh: 接触龟或其生活环境后应洗手，儿童尤其需要照护者帮助。
summary.en: Wash hands after handling turtles or their habitat, especially with children.

body.zh:
## 外表不能判断是否带菌
宠物龟即使看起来健康，也可能携带沙门菌。接触龟、龟缸水或用品后，再摸食物和嘴巴，可能让细菌进入人体。

## 把洗手变成固定步骤
接触后用肥皂和流动水洗手，帮助儿童洗干净；不要在准备食物的地方清洗龟缸用品，也不要亲吻宠物龟。出现严重腹泻、发热或脱水时及时咨询医生。
body.en:
## Appearance does not reveal germs
A turtle can carry Salmonella even when it looks healthy. Germs can spread from the turtle, tank water or equipment to food and then to the mouth.

## Make handwashing routine
Wash with soap and running water after contact and help children wash properly. Keep habitat cleaning away from food preparation areas and do not kiss turtles. Seek medical advice for severe diarrhoea, fever or dehydration.

sources.title: CDC · Salmonella and pet turtles (2024)

imageAlt: A small turtle held in a hand

title.zh: 刷牙后马上漱口，会冲走牙膏里的氟吗？
title.en: After brushing, spit rather than rinse immediately

summary.zh: 刷完吐出多余牙膏，避免立即漱口有助于氟留在牙面。
summary.en: Spitting out excess toothpaste without an immediate rinse helps fluoride remain on teeth.

body.zh:
## 给氟一点时间
含氟牙膏有助于预防龋齿。刷牙后吐出多余牙膏，不必立即用水漱口；马上漱口会冲淡留在牙面上的氟。

## 儿童需要成人协助
儿童应使用适合年龄的牙膏用量，成人协助刷牙并避免吞食牙膏。有关含氟浓度、用量和个人龋齿风险，可咨询牙医。
body.en:
## Let fluoride stay on the teeth
Fluoride toothpaste helps prevent tooth decay. Spit out excess toothpaste after brushing rather than rinsing immediately with water, which washes away concentrated fluoride.

## Children need help
Use an age-appropriate amount for children, help them brush and avoid swallowing toothpaste. Ask a dentist about fluoride concentration, amounts and individual risk.

sources.title: NHS · How to keep your teeth clean

imageAlt: A toothbrush and toothpaste

title.zh: 心脏病发作不一定只有胸痛
title.en: A heart attack can involve more than chest pain

summary.zh: 胸部不适、气短或放射到手臂和下颌的疼痛都需要重视。
summary.en: Chest discomfort, breathlessness and pain in the arm or jaw are warning signs.

body.zh:
## 症状并不总是一模一样
心脏病发作可能出现胸部压迫或不适、气短，以及手臂、肩部、背部、颈部或下颌的不适，也可能伴恶心、头晕或异常疲劳。并非每个人都有相同的症状。

## 怀疑时不要等待
怀疑心脏病发作应立即呼叫当地急救电话，不要等待症状自行消失或自行驾车就医。留在患者身边并遵循急救人员指示；经过培训的旁观者可按现场情况实施心肺复苏或使用自动体外除颤器。
body.en:
## Symptoms are not identical for everyone
A heart attack may cause chest pressure or discomfort, shortness of breath, or discomfort in the arm, shoulder, back, neck or jaw. Nausea, light-headedness or unusual fatigue can also occur. People do not all experience the same symptoms.

## Do not wait if you suspect one
Call local emergency services immediately rather than waiting for symptoms to pass or driving yourself. Stay with the person and follow emergency instructions. Trained bystanders may be able to provide CPR or use an automated external defibrillator.

sources.title: CDC · About heart attack symptoms and recovery (2024)

title.zh: 失去之后的悲伤，没有统一的时间表
title.en: Grief does not follow a single timetable

summary.zh: 悲伤的表现因人而异；当日常生活难以维持时，可以寻求支持。
summary.en: Grief varies from person to person; support is available when coping becomes difficult.

body.zh:
## 每个人的反应不同
经历亲人离世或其他重要失去后，人可能感到悲伤、麻木、愤怒或疲惫。这些感受并不一定按固定顺序出现，也不需要拿自己和别人比较。

## 不必独自承受
可以向信任的人谈谈，也可以寻求心理专业人员的支持。如果情绪长期影响睡眠、学习或日常生活，值得主动求助；如果存在立即伤害自己或他人的危险，应联系当地急救服务并寻求身边人的即时帮助。
body.en:
## Reactions differ
After a death or another significant loss, people may feel sadness, numbness, anger or exhaustion. Feelings do not necessarily follow a fixed order, and there is no need to compare your response with someone else’s.

## You do not have to cope alone
Talk with someone you trust or seek support from a mental-health professional. If feelings persistently disrupt sleep, study or daily life, asking for help is worthwhile. If there is immediate danger of harm to yourself or others, contact local emergency services and seek immediate support from someone nearby.

sources.title: NHS · Help with grief after bereavement or loss

imageAlt: Hands held in a gesture of support

title.zh: 一次血压偏高，就能确诊高血压吗？
title.en: One high blood-pressure reading is not the whole picture

summary.zh: 血压会波动，医生可能结合多次测量或家庭监测评估。
summary.en: Blood pressure varies; clinicians may use repeated or home measurements.

body.zh:
## 一次读数需要放在背景中看
紧张、活动和测量方式都可能影响血压。一次偏高值得记录和咨询，但通常不能单独作为长期高血压的完整判断。医生可能建议重复测量或家庭监测。

## 按指导记录，不自行改药
使用合适的上臂式设备，安静坐好、双脚平放、手臂有支撑，测量时不说话。记录结果并带给医生；不要凭一次家庭读数自行增减药物。明显不适或严重症状应及时寻求急救。
body.en:
## Put a reading in context
Stress, activity and measurement technique can affect blood pressure. A high reading is worth recording and discussing, but one reading alone usually does not establish the full picture. A clinician may recommend repeat or home measurements.

## Record as advised; do not change medicines alone
Use a suitable upper-arm monitor, sit quietly with feet flat and the arm supported, and avoid talking during the reading. Share records with your clinician rather than changing medication based on a single home result. Seek urgent help for severe symptoms.

sources.title: NHS · Blood pressure test
NHS England · Home blood pressure monitoring
